Guideline: Use the Base UI render prop instead of Radix asChild
Description: MUI Base UI (@base-ui-components/react, submodules/base-ui) uses the render prop (<Dialog.Trigger render={<Button />} />) for polymorphic element composition
Do: Compose custom triggers and controls with the render prop so ARIA attributes, refs and event handlers merge cleanly
Don't: Nest a <button> inside <Dialog.Trigger> without render (creates invalid nested <button><button> HTML)

Guideline: Style interactive states with Base UI data-* attributes
Description: Base UI exposes state machine transitions via data-[popup-open], data-[highlighted], data-[checked], data-[disabled], and data-[side]
Do: Target data-[popup-open] and data-[highlighted] in Tailwind v4 or YoloThemePreset CSS rules
Don't: Track open/hover state in duplicate React useState hooks just to toggle CSS classes
Code Bad: const [hover, setHover] = useState(false); // manual hover state for styling

Guideline: Use data-[starting-style] and data-[ending-style] for CSS transitions
Description: Base UI keeps popups mounted during exit animations and applies data-[starting-style] on enter and data-[ending-style] on exit
Do: Define enter/exit opacity and scale transitions with data-[starting-style]:opacity-0 data-[ending-style]:opacity-0 and motion-reduce:transition-none
Don't: Unmount popovers immediately with {open && <Popover.Popup />} which cuts off exit transitions

Guideline: Always include Portal + Positioner + Popup hierarchy
Description: Base UI separates portaling (<Popover.Portal>), anchor positioning (<Popover.Positioner sideOffset={8}>) and surface (<Popover.Popup>)
Do: Wrap Popup inside Portal and Positioner so collision detection and z-index stacking work reliably

Guideline: Bind inputs with Base UI Field.Root, Field.Label, Field.Description and Field.Error
Description: Field.Root automatically wires id, htmlFor, aria-describedby and aria-invalid across Label, Control, Description and Error
Do: Wrap form controls in <Field.Root> with a visible <Field.Label> and <Field.Error>
Don't: Render standalone <Input placeholder="Email" /> without a connected label or error region

Guideline: Preserve roving tabindex in Tabs, Menu, Select and RadioGroup
Description: Base UI composite widgets implement WAI-ARIA roving tabindex, arrow-key navigation and typeahead out of the box
Do: Keep composite items inside their semantic Group/List parent (<Tabs.List>, <Menu.Popup>, <RadioGroup>)
Don't: Insert arbitrary focusable buttons with tabIndex={0} that break arrow-key traversal inside a Menu or TabsList

Guideline: Provide Dialog.Title and Dialog.Description on every modal
Description: Screen readers announce a dialog by its aria-labelledby (Dialog.Title) and aria-describedby (Dialog.Description)
Do: Include <Dialog.Title> and <Dialog.Close> in every <Dialog.Popup> and use AlertDialog for destructive confirmations
Don't: Open a <Dialog.Popup> with no title or keyboard escape/close affordance

Guideline: Bind Base UI primitives to YoloThemePreset CSS variables
Description: @yolo-rs/ui-plugin injects --yolo-* and --md-sys-color-* variables for all 7 YoloThemePresets (neutral, m3, fluent, apple, omarchy, hyprland, aphrody)
Do: Import virtual:yolo-theme and reference semantic tokens (bg-card, text-foreground, border-border, var(--yolo-accent-primary))
Don't: Hardcode Tailwind palette colors (bg-indigo-600, text-zinc-100) directly inside reusable Base UI wrappers

Guideline: Keep Base UI / Radix / Shadcn TSX compatible with yolo-migrator
Description: crates/yolo-migrator (src/shadcn_registry.rs) lowers Base UI, Radix Primitives and Shadcn UI components to Dioxus 0.8, WGPU, Egui, Cosmic, GTK4 and Qt6 QML
Do: Use canonical component names (Button, Dialog, Tabs, Switch, Slider, Select, Popover, Tooltip, Accordion) so yolo-migrate lowers them losslessly to all 6 Rust backends
Don't: Hide UI structure behind dynamic eval() or untyped runtime component factories
Code Good: bun ui migrate AudioSettings.tsx --target all --preset neutral

Guideline: Use Base UI NumberField with ScrubArea for numeric parameters
Description: Inspector panels in CAD, audio and design tools benefit from scrubbable numeric inputs with locale-aware formatting and keyboard step increments
Don't: Use <input type="number"> which suffers from inconsistent browser spinners and scroll-wheel hijacking
